chunks: My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Sa'd bin Abdullah, from Ya'qoub bin Yazid, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Abdul-Rahman bin Hajjaj, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him),
with regards to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «Then she laughed, and we gave her a glad tiding with Ishaq.» He said: She menstruated.

key_terms.حَاضَتْ: She menstruated (the explanation provided by the Imam)
key_terms.فَضَحِكَتْ: She laughed (the word in question in the Quranic verse)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quranic verse 'Then she laughed' mean in relation to Sarah's menstruation?
ai.summary: In Ma'ani al-Akhbar, Shaykh al-Saduq records this unique linguistic interpretation where Imam al-Sadiq (AS) identifies Sarah's 'laughter' in Surah Hud not as an expression of joy, but as a reference to menstruation (hayd). This exegesis highlights the flexibility of Quranic terminology in describing physical states and underscores the Imam's role in clarifying subtle semantic nuances within the divine text.
